sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Erosion (nullifies effects that penetrate nullifying or invulnerability effects when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 180% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 100% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
